recipes.label: Mixing
recipes.explain: Mixing trains on the interior and on both edges, so every sampling path runs through trained ground.

recipes.label: Multi-task
recipes.explain: Multi-task trains only on the edges. The joint path crosses an interior it never saw.

recipes.label: Joint only
recipes.explain: Joint only never sees a clean condition. Text-to-image and captioning run along the edges, exactly where it never trained.
